summary: WISeKey International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that shareholders approved its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands at an EGM held September 9, 2026. The approved merger agreement, dated June 26, 2026, merges WISeKey into wholly owned subsidiary WISeKey International Corp. (BVI), which becomes the publicly traded parent surviving company. No price, stake, or premium terms were stated. Closing remains subject to customary conditions. The structural change is tax and corporate, not a change of control; watch for completion timing and any share-conversion mechanics for Nasdaq/SIX holders.
